title: Point transport realizes the compatible finite coefficient transports
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$, $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $\mathcal O_E$, $\varpi$, $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$ of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g_s=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for geometric Frobenius $\gamma$, and let $N\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ be derived-complete integral constructible [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with $N_n=N\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_n$. Let $\mathcal R(N)$ be its coherent reduction tower from [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use $\Gamma(s,-)=\operatorname{Fib}_s$ of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], the completed pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the point transports $\iota_N,\iota_{N_n}$ of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. The finite maps $\iota_{N_n}:\Gamma(s,N_n)\to\Gamma(s,Lg_s^*N_n)$ are evaluations of a morphism of the quotient-induced towers, with transitions obtained before passage to the derived categories of individual levels. Under the canonical completeness identifications
$$\Gamma(s,N)\simeq R\varprojlim_n\Gamma(s,N_n),\qquad
\Gamma(s,Lg_s^*N)\simeq R\varprojlim_n\Gamma(s,Lg_s^*N_n),$$
the realization of this tower morphism is $\iota_N$. In particular this is the integral map defined by part (b) of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], rather than an arbitrary map having the same individual reductions. The identifications and this assertion are natural in $N$.
